description: Returns transaction details for a confirmed transaction

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The slot number of the block to retrieve encoded as u64 (64-bit unsigned integer) integer

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: The encoding format for account data. It can be jsonParsed or n/a if using JS getParsedTransaction

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: finalized
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block confirmed by the supermajority of the cluster as having reached maximum lockout, meaning the cluster has recognized this block as finalized

sub_parameters.name: confirmed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block that has been voted on by supermajority of the cluster

sub_parameters.name: processed
sub_parameters.description: It is not supported for this method

sub_parameters.name: maxSupportedTransactionVersion
sub_parameters.description: The maximum transaction version to return in responses. If the requested block contains a transaction with a higher version, an error will be returned. If this parameter is omitted, only legacy transactions will be returned, and a block containing any versioned transaction will prompt an error

sub_parameters.name: legacy
sub_parameters.description: The older transaction format with no additional benefit
The additional support for Address Lookup Tables

result.description: The result will be null if the specified transaction is not confirmed otherwise an object with the following fields:

result.slot.description: The slot number in which the transaction was processed

result.parsedTransaction.description: The parsed transaction object with the following fields:

result.parsedTransaction.signatures.description: An array of signatures on the transaction

result.parsedTransaction.parsedMessage.description: The parsed message of the transaction

result.parsedTransaction.parsedMessage.a.description: An array of public keys involved in the transaction

result.parsedTransaction.parsedMessage.i.description: An array of instructions that were executed in the block's transactions

result.parsedTransaction.parsedMessage.r.description: The recent blockhash from the transaction

result.parsedTransaction.parsedMessage.a.description: An array of address lookups that were performed during the execution of transactions in the block

result.blockTime.description: The estimated production time, as Unix timestamp (seconds since the Unix epoch). It's null if not available

result.meta.description: The transaction status metadata object with the following fields:

result.meta.err.description: Error code if the transaction failed or null if the transaction succeeds

result.meta.fee.description: The total fees paid by all transactions in the block encoded as u64 integer

result.meta.preBalances.description: An array of lamport balances for each account in the block before the transactions were processed

result.meta.postBalances.description: An array of lamport balances for each account in the block after the transactions were processed

result.meta.parsedInnerInstructions.description: List of inner instructions or omitted if inner instruction recording was not yet enabled during this transaction.

result.meta.preTokenBalances.description: An array of token balances for each token account in the block before the transactions were processed (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled)

result.meta.postTokenBalances.description: An array of token balances for each token account in the block after the transactions were processed (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled)

result.meta.logMessages.description: An array of strings containing any log messages generated by the block's transactions (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled)

result.meta.rewards.description: An object containing information about the rewards earned by the block's validators (only present if the rewards are requested). It has the following fields:

result.meta.rewards.pubkey.description: The public key of the account that received the award encoded as base-58 string

result.meta.rewards.lamports.description: The number of reward lamports credited or debited by the account

result.meta.rewards.postBalance.description: The account balance in lamports after the reward was applied

result.meta.rewards.rewardType.description: The type of reward. It could be fee, rent, voting, staking

result.meta.rewards.commission.description: The vote account commission when the reward was credited, only present for voting and staking rewards

result.meta.loadedAddresses.description: The list of loaded addresses objects

result.meta.loadedAddresses.readonly.description: The ordered list of base-58 encoded addresses for readonly loaded accounts

result.meta.loadedAddresses.writable.description: The ordered list of base-58 encoded addresses for writable loaded accounts

result.meta.version.description: The transaction version. It's undefined if maxSupportedTransactionVersion is not set in the requested parameters
